specName: Document pages for bugs and ideas

FR-001.title: Opening a bug shows a story page that states where the bug stands

FR-002.title: The lead sentence is one of six, chosen from the bug state

FR-003.title: One meta line, each fact omitted when unknown

FR-004.title: Three steps in order, done or next

FR-005.title: A step with no report says so and names the footer button

FR-006.title: What changed lists changed files as rows and shows the diff

FR-007.title: Risks and open questions listed at the end, omitted when none

FR-008.title: Story, Assessment, Fix and Test tabs; missing disabled; landing rule

FR-009.title: A decided idea shows a decision page

FR-010.title: Scorecard rows with a rating tone that does not rely on colour alone

FR-011.title: Five-stage rail; missing stage disabled; latest stage landing

FR-012.title: Shown values come from recognised lists only

FR-013.title: Missing sections omitted; unparseable report falls back to raw

FR-014.title: Footer next-step buttons behave as today

FR-015.title: Pages update when a report file changes

FR-016.title: One reading column, existing tokens, keeps the outline

FR-017.title: No text repeated in two places

FR-018.title: One Storybook story per page state

FR-019.title: Docs describe the pages, tabs and rail

expectations: Analysis and Converge report pages and their Reports group
links between an idea and its spec
changes to the Bugs and Ideas sidebar panes
a pull request or merge before the owner reviews in Storybook
context: area: apps/vscode/src/features/spec-viewer (reportPanels.ts readReportPanel; specViewerProvider.ts showReport/updateReportContent re-renders full HTML on every tab switch; NavState carries coreDocs, currentDoc, reportActions but no bug/idea data)
area: apps/vscode/src/features/reports, bugs, ideas (ReportFolder.fields parses only the header bullets; bugState and knownValue allow-lists; body sections are not parsed anywhere)

area: apps/vscode/webview/src/spec-viewer (App.tsx mounts #markdown-content from markdownHtml; the Overview pane is the precedent for a component page; buildToc fills the outline from h2[id]; ReportFooter posts reportAction)

area: prototype on design/processes-style (DirectionA.tsx, model.ts, parse.ts ~300 lines, about 195 lines of psa- CSS on existing tokens; readBug ignores test.md; leads, step states and handoff are hard-coded to one state)

area: fixtures (apps/vscode/tests/fixtures/bug-reports has cart-total-skips-first with three reports and slug-keeps-spaces with one; decision shapes: Scorecard table Criterion|Rating|Justification, Verdict & Rationale, If go / If needs-clarification / Revisit trigger)
constraint: styles under webview/styles/spec-viewer are bundled into apps/copilot-canvas/vendor/viewer.css, so npm run test:canvas must be re-run
constraint: escapeHtml is safe for element content only; design tokens rule: body text on --text-body/--text-primary
constraint: visual work is reviewed in Storybook before any PR
intent: A bug opens on a story page and a decided idea on a decision page, in the Document look, with raw reports as tabs

decisions.decision: Build the page model on the host and ship it in the initial nav state
decisions.why: A report panel re-renders its whole HTML on every switch and file change, so the model is always current and stories can call the same pure builders
decisions.rejected: Parsing in the webview, which only receives one document

decisions.why: The reading column and the outline are keyed to that element
decisions.rejected: A sibling pane like the Overview, which gets no outline

decisions.decision: Story is a first, file-less document entry on a bug; an idea Decision stage renders the decision page
decisions.why: The rail and switchDocument already handle document entries and the read-only allow-list permits it
decisions.rejected: A client-side tab toggle, lost on every reload

decisions.decision: Six bug leads derived from bugState plus the test report
decisions.why: bugState folds four situations into to-fix and must not change
decisions.rejected: Extending BugState, which drives pane grouping and footer buttons

decisions.decision: A small fragment renderer instead of renderMarkdown per section
decisions.why: renderMarkdown adds heading ids and comment controls

decisions.decision: New lists IDEA_RATINGS and BUG_CHECK_RESULTS; allow-lists move to fs-free modules
decisions.why: Every state-like value must be recognised, and Storybook cannot import fs

plan.summary: Pure parse and model layer on the host, page rendered by Preact inside the content element, Story as a document entry, one new CSS partial
plan.key_finding: Report panels reload their whole HTML on every tab switch, so the model must ride in the initial nav state and Story must be a host-side document type

tasks.summary: 27 tasks: 1 setup, 14 foundational in three waves plus wiring, 4 per page story, 1 Storybook, 3 polish

approach: Pure builders in features/reports turn report text into a BugStory or IdeaDecision. readReportPanel calls them and the model travels as NavState.report. The webview renders it inside #markdown-content with rp- classes from one new partial, and Storybook builds the same pages from fixtures.
